spec: The vanilla Q-Explorer prototype is the specification for this port.
note: Ignat asked specifically: check whether ALL FEATURES were copied from the vanilla into the React port. Differences from the vanilla are findings unless listed as deliberate below.
deliberate_differences: Login fields use MUI floating labels; the vanilla still has labels above its login fields (card 374px vs 399px). Flagged to Ignat, awaiting his call.
Login card copy is translated; the vanilla's login is hardcoded German and ignores the language switch.
Raw-data column filters are text inputs, not selects: multi-column filtering is an MUI X Pro feature and the licence tier is unsettled.
status_running and status_in_progress share one label; the status filter matches on the label so picking 'In Progress' returns both.
Tooltips Delete/Pause are translated in the port; the vanilla hardcodes them in English/German.
